text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Seeing that smile on your face, Trainer...
makes it truly sink in that we won.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah...... To be able to share this joy
with you like this...
is truly a wonderful blessing...
choice_data_list: We can keep sharing things from now on too!
Do I look like I'm dreaming?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
I desire that as well.
Very, very strongly—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah... Was it perhaps a bit...
unbecoming of me to seek victory
in such a manner?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
However... that is my true feeling.
I will make every effort... so that
I may share it with you once again.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe.
Yet your eyes tell me...
that this is indeed reality.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I-I'm sorry.
For staring at you... Um...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I shall continue to strive,
so that I do not betray your trust..."
